content: Orgahi Nor Abrama nnio' wutnu nnio'a la duratni-waitni
Lera ida ne Abrama ndarat nan de Orgahi-Orha'a Nhar lirni la Niwra:

content.text: “Yan mumta'ata Abram. A' di de tiokmu-nhiepmu, onnila omliernohora A' di de wniahlamu hota inponni memna.

content: Abrama nwahla: “Matroma, O' nanpena mak kodi plola-ktaryatu, hya' maka hota Muala mai a'u, yoma hota muat die ukleha upa-a'na, ne mak kodi plolli la ro'mu di de Elieser, makden Damsika mniotni de.
O' edon Muala durti-wait mai a'u, nhi'nande a hopopnu ida nhi'a mak kodi plol la re'a-tnia'ru.”
Mere Orgahi lirni: “Edonna, Elieser di edon nhi' mak kodi plolli la re'emu-tniarmu, mere a'na raralammu. E' nanpena mak kodi plol la re'emu-tniarmu.”
Noka Orgahi Nodia Abram pa nlergot la tio'ora, na'nama Nal lir la: “Mpuatniar la heyanna. Wtion mak kden heyanna taken niana mriekan nana. Emkade wal lia hota o duratmu-waitmu.”
Lira re honona Abram npesiaya pa nha'ar aranni la. Hade pede Orgahi Nreiniana-na'nan Abram de, mak kaplol la E yamkekni.
Noma Orgahi lirni owa'an la: “A' di de Orgahi-Orha'a Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu mak kodi o' pa mliergot la leta Ur (gen miaka Kasdim rdella) totpa Agala geni di la o'a pa mhi'a la nhiakarmu.”
Mere Abrama nakot la: “Matroma, O' mak kodi plola-ktaryatu. Mere emkameni totpena agat niohora hari honona a gah'u?”

Orgahi lirni la: “Agala kniau id tiy o'a. Mua'ala sapi rara ida, umarnu anni wotelu, pipi rara mak umarnu anni wotelu, duma ltiata id maka umarnu anni wotelu, loktieru ida me lmo'ma maru (merpati) trapriapi ida pa muodia mai A'u.”
Noka Abram na'ala hare honona pa nala la Orgahi, nhartietia la woru, na'nama nwatemna deullu nenenan pa nken tiemna la deul walli onni, mere onu-ma'nu rde edonna nhartia.
La'pa onu-ma'nu dawra, rtailia nhiuri-wnia'ana re ananni, dewade Abrama nawohora re.
La'pa lera nmel wa de Abram nanin hal memna. Noka melmela-kalkalma nma kaduw nana nhi'nande Abrama namta'at wenna.
Orgahi Nhar lirni la Abrama: “Plollolli de, de duratmu-waitmu hota rhi' do'ona-dakan la noh meheni ida, maka gahani atia'a, ne hota rwa'ata-rwa'ara me ramuki-rama'ala, la'pa anni rahu wogata ralamni.
Mere hairi meni mak kwa'ata-kwawa'ara hare, hota Aghi'a pa hoptutu-hoplera totpena hota ir rlergot la hande, de rodi miemna-ral memna re'eni-tniarnu.
Mere o' di de hota muodi kalwiedni-paitiotni pa mlia' temna up ulmu-tgar ulmu mak kmati olekwa. De la'pa moratmu nhamra me nihimu ntuini nanpa omuerun la ketarmu me retru la lumanmu.
Mere tuwu wogatni nanpa hota duratmu-waitmu rawali owa'an mai handi, onnila makden Amori do'oni-halli edonna ntu'tu ma'ta pa Aghoptutu-ghoplera.”
La'awa lera nmel wa noma Abram namkek de ai woka
ida mokalli nlergot la ralamni nor wutga hulu nmormiori nlola nhiuri-wnia'ana ananni letgarni.
La' ler de de, Orgahi Nhi'a nnio'a id la Nora Abrama, lirni: “Agala gen dilla duratmu-waitmu. Noha di nden nek la Mesir gerlawanni de nodi liarni la gerlawlawan de, de gerlawna Efrata,
ne makden Keni re nohananni-taniaratni, makden Kenas, makden Kadmon,
makden Heta, makden Feris, makden Refaim,
makden Amori, makden Kana'ana, makden Girgasi, me makden Yebusi re nohananni-taniaratni de. Honona re Agala tiy o'a.”

footnotes.text: 15.17 15:17 Riy dom de rwarora ayat di emkadi: Abraham namkek de kekna ida maka ai miokla nlergot la ralamni.
